responsibility: Declares the generic edit-distance and best-match framework used for spelling suggestions in diagnostics. It exposes string distance and closest-candidate APIs, the cutoff heuristic, edit_distance_traits specializations, and the templated best_match accumulator that can operate on C strings or other string-like types such as tree identifiers via traits-based adaptation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public spellcheck interfaces and generic best_match/edit_distance_traits templates used by other diagnostics code. Unlike gcc/spellcheck.cc, this header is the reusable type-and-API definition layer, not the concrete edit-distance implementation or selftest body.
